case.summary: The alert was triggered by an autonomous monitor detecting purchases by three different customers through one rare device profile, including a $300.00 online transaction on card C00750-K2. The transaction model scored the flagged transaction at 0.832, and the episode shows mixed-channel activity across different devices and in-person channels. The cardholder was contacted via step-up authentication and denied making the flagged transactions while confirming they still possess the card. The final verdict is fraud with a pattern of account takeover, resulting in the final actions to BLOCK_CARD and CREATE_CASE.
